To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the outage probability performance of cooperative cognitive relay networks with proactive relay selections depends on the number of relays, and the performance saturates when the maximum transmit power or the maximum interference power is large.

the outage probability of cooperative cognitive networks is a monotonically decreasing function of the number of relays, the outage probability is a monotonously increasing function of the maximum transmit power and maximum interference power, and cooperative cognitive networks with a large number of relays and a large maximum interference power have the best performance.
the performance of cooperative networks with proactive relay depends considerably on the maximum transmit power and the maximum interference power.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the performance analysis of cognitive networks with proactive relays and provides a useful framework for evaluating their performance.
the design and optimization of cooperative cognitive networks for the next generation wireless communications.
the design of cooperative relay selection schemes that are able to achieve the optimal performance limits of the system under study.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed cooperative cognitive networks are capable of providing high performance gains in the presence of proactive relay selection.
the proposed framework is very useful for designing and evaluating cognitive relay networks with proactive relay-selection schemes.
cooperative cognitive networks are more robust and reliable in terms of outage probability than their dual-hop counterparts.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed framework can be exploited for the performance evaluation and optimization of cooperative cognitive networks under proactive relay selection.
the derived results provide a valuable tool for system design, optimization and performance evaluation of cooperative cognitive networks.
the proposed framework provides a powerful tool for evaluating the performance of cooperative systems with proactive relay selection in a simple and accurate way.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance of cooperative networks can be improved by using proactive relay selection.
the proposed outage analysis framework can be readily extended to other cooperative networks with proactive relay selections.
the proposed outage probability expression is a useful tool for the design of cooperative cognitive networks.
